automation.coordinates: Fresh accessibility frames for contact targets; matched normalized drags inside verified accessible collection/timeline bounds; exact zero edge origin for back.

warnings: The conversation settled with a small changing region. Its destination composer was separately verified before scrolling; no completely-static-screen claim is made.

automation.fixture_exception: Beeper's unlabeled pinned button requires its recorded family-avatar identifier. Re-record if the avatar changes. The capture helper instead resolves a fresh accessible parent-button frame.
automation.cleanup: Stopped only the selected phone's Argent runner after successful replays. Existing user sign-ins were preserved.

capture.argent_recording_limitation: screen-recording-start is not supported on ios device (kind 'device' not supported)
capture.fallback: Wired AVFoundation iPhone screen source, never a camera or Mac-window screenshot loop
capture.timing: Original sample presentation timestamps retained. Source streams report nominal 60 Hz; constant 60 captured frames per second is not claimed.
capture.lock_recovery: No frames arrived while the phone locked; capture passed after unlocking and disabling Auto-Lock.

export.editing: Trim idle intervals, align measured motion boundaries, pad only idle holds. No speed changes or reverse/repeated app motion.

privacy.mask: 16 x 64 downsampling, upscaling, Gaussian blur sigma 18 and dark backing over the whole inbox body including translucent bottom toolbars; active through both transitions.
privacy.glass_header_fix: Actual inbox rows showed through the translucent header in an early draft. Final masked scenes hold the visually reviewed safe initial native header; the status area is opaque black.
privacy.boundary_fix: Enforce whole-frame scene budgets and reset concatenated timestamps to avoid one-frame redaction-state drift.
privacy.approved_conversation: Readable, as explicitly permitted by the user.
visual_review: full-resolution inbox and conversation export samples
final contact sheet covering all 20 seconds at two samples per second
privacy.limits: OCR is supplementary evidence, not an anonymity guarantee. Source files, probes and earlier drafts remain local and are not approved for sharing. Only the final linked export passed all checks.

verification.command: uv run python -m unittest discover -s demo -p 'test_*.py' -v
coverage: no motion acceleration or backward edits
real FFmpeg render dimensions, fps, silence, opaque status interior and overwrite refusal
verification.native_helpers: Wired recorder and AppKit frame generator compiled and ran. Preserved Vision checker ran successfully on the final artifact.
verification.warnings: Native helpers compile with macOS 27 AVFoundation deprecation warnings; they remain functional. No app/framework code changed, so full app builds and tests were not rerun.
verification.exact_feedback: Status checked. No Exact framework costs or diary were created for this capture task, and no pre-existing feedback was sent.

safety.read_receipt_caveat: Opening the approved conversation can send a read receipt, as disclosed before the drive.

comparison_limits: Installed apps were recorded, not rebuilt or modified.
Display names, link-preview layouts and voice controls differ and were not concealed.
This is a matched workflow demonstration, not a pixel-identical parity claim.
